title: Weyland Joyner
text:
Summary
Senior software engineer with 12+ years of experience building applied systems across AI, cloud infrastructure, and client-facing products. Early contributor to conversational AI systems (IBM Watson era), long-time technical lead delivering AWS/GCP architectures for Fortune 500 and public-sector clients, and trusted advisor to executive stakeholders on technology strategy. Known for operating effectively under ambiguity, rapidly prototyping novel systems, and translating cutting-edge technology into real-world use.

title: Weyland Joyner
text:
Selected Experience

Applied AI & Special Projects
Mercer Street Labs / Moth+Flame Founder · Consultant · Acting Head of Engineering · 2023-Present

Brought in as a solo consultant to design and build a new AI-first flagship product for VR training used by U.S. military clients (Army, Air Force, Navy, SOCOM)
Architected a generative system enabling subject-matter experts (e.g., drill sergeants) to author immersive training experiences via natural language, producing structured specifications consumed by video, audio, and VR pipelines
Integrated modern LLM APIs into end-to-end content generation workflows, coordinating multi-modal outputs and downstream processing
Conducted a ground-up audit of legacy systems, decommissioned outdated tooling, and rebuilt core engineering workflows
At CEO request, spun up and led a distributed skunkworks team (including displaced Ukrainian engineers), effectively acting as head of engineering to execute organizational and technical transformation
Worked directly with executive leadership outside the formal org chart to deliver new capabilities under tight timelines and sensitive client constraints




Cloud Architecture & Delivery Leadership
Cloudreach Senior Engineer / Technical Lead · 2018-2023

Led design and delivery of cloud-native systems on AWS and GCP for Fortune 500 and public-sector clients
Technical lead for a 7-person team building streaming and data-processing systems for transportation and infrastructure use cases
Architected pipelines consolidating weather, incident, and operational data into BigQuery for real-time and analytical workloads
Built internal tools and web applications supporting operational decision-making
Served as senior technical interface to client leadership, participating in strategy discussions and advising on modernization efforts
Maintained hands-on ownership of core codebases while leading architecture and delivery




Conversational AI & Full-Stack Engineering
IBM Watson (via Langa) Consulting Engineer · 2015-2018

Designed and built full-stack Node.js applications leveraging Watson NLP APIs (chat, information extraction) for education use cases
Advised Watson Education leadership on adoption of Node.js and React in a historically Java-centric organization, mentoring internal engineers on modern JS practices
Led UX and data-visualization design (React + D3.js) for nontechnical users, working directly with teachers and administrators to translate real-world workflows into AI-assisted tools
Operated as a skunkworks team delivering multi-month proof-of-concept products presented to IBM leadership for productionization




Technology Strategy & Executive Advisory
Blackstone (BXII)
Technical Advisor (Additional Responsibility)

Personally requested by Blackstone infrastructure leadership to assess portfolio company technology
Led stakeholder meetings with private equity leadership and operating companies
Produced architecture reviews, roadmaps, and written assessments to inform investment and modernization decisions




Operations & Crisis Leadership
Humanitarian Aid Organization (Ukraine)
Co-Founder / Operations Lead

Co-founded and led an international aid organization during the early Russo-Ukrainian war
Built and operated supply chains across 3–4 continents under wartime constraints
Led a distributed team (~10 people) coordinating evacuations and humanitarian logistics from active conflict zones
Managed security, logistics, and rapid decision-making in high-risk environments

title: Hello World
text:
This is the first post on my new blog. I’m planning to use this space to share thoughts, ideas, and things I’m learning.
I built this site with Quarto, which makes it easy to write content in Markdown and publish to the web. The aesthetic is intentionally minimal - I prefer focusing on content over flashy design.
More to come soon.
